name: What a Legend!
source: Story about a young man that goes to the biggest city of the realm to lose his virginity but ends up meeting a mysterious woman who sends him on an epic quest. A quest full of sexual encounters, unhappy housewives, beautiful damsels, comely magical creatures, and the chance to become a legend.
translation: 故事讲述了一名年轻人前往该国最大的城市失去童贞，但最终遇到了一位神秘女子，这名女子派他进行史诗般的探索。一场充满性遭遇、不幸的家庭主妇、美丽的少女、美丽的神奇生物以及成为传奇的机会的探索。
